title: Identity-Locked Switchboard
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Same-Face Makeup Era Matrix, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Same-Face Makeup Era Matrix; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-natural-base first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-look-switch-one, 03-look-switch-two, 04-look-switch-three, 05-look-switch-four, 06-look-switch-five, 07-look-switch-six, 08-detail-proof-board, 09-campaign-finale. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
